items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: I took lessons with, uh, uh, Uh, Narmie Pond. Snire, Manny Perez

ctx.x: So, you'd have been what, about eighteen, twenty- I was about sixteen or seventeen. Oh, twenty-six years ago. Uh-huh. But how long did you take lessons with him?
Oh, I think, living with Shawnee, about a couple years, and then I took lessons with, uh, uh, Uh, Narmie Pond. Snire, Manny Perez, Uh-huh. and later on with, uh, several castigots.
What, um, what kind of thing did they, did they teach you? You know what I mean?
